meta.description:
The project MUST publish contacts and process for reporting vulnerabilities.

Checked through the project's Security Insights data with the `security-insights/vulnerability-reporting-contact` policy.
meta.name: Vulnerability Reporting Contacts

meta.description: Ensures there is a contact for vulnerability reporting in SI

contact.code: has(predicates[0].data.project) ? ('vulnerability-reporting' in predicates[0].data.project ? ('contact' in predicates[0].data.project['vulnerability-reporting'] ? predicates[0].data.project['vulnerability-reporting']['contact'] : null) : null) : null

error.message: No vulnerability reporting contact found in SI
error.guidance: Add a vulnerability reporting contact under the project data in the SI yaml file

assessment.message: Found vulnerability reporting contact in Security Insights
